'''Dan Lujan''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[2000 Las Vegas Grand Slam]] on 6 May 2000 with [[Carbon Chamber Testing / My Favorite Decoration|CCT with SAC]], according to Tim Guzman's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d709">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-05-09-grand-slam-in-vegas-pass-me-a-cold-beerd709/ grand-slam-in-vegas-pass-me-a-cold-beer], DeckTech (Tim "Info Broker" Guzman, 9 May 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-05-09-grand-slam-in-vegas-pass-me-a-cold-beerd709/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
